subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, task, and plugin SDK lifecycle state, or remain internal to the canonical continuation lifecycle?
rationale: A coherent answer affects persisted cron data, task status, Gateway protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, QA tooling, and external plugin APIs, so implementation correctness alone cannot choose the intended contract.

options.title: Keep deferral internal
options.body: Keep task rows running and use the canonical continuation lifecycle without adding a general public status or SDK classifier.

options.title: Approve public deferred state
options.body: Add a coherent nonterminal deferred state across cron, tasks, protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, QA, and SDK with upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow to cron history
options.body: Expose deferred only in cron run history while task and SDK surfaces retain existing canonical lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep deferral internal
recommendation.body: Keep task rows running and use the canonical continuation lifecycle without adding a general public status or SDK classifier.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history provides the strongest available cross-cutting ownership signal for the agent, cron, and public runtime contract surfaces.
